settings.title: Research and Analyze the Industry
settings.text: We immerse ourselves in the fashion landscape, conducting thorough research to anticipate upcoming trends, identify key influencers, and understand evolving consumer preferences.

settings.title: Shortlist Designers and Garments
settings.text: We handpick designers and garments, guided by the latest collections from major fashion weeks and exhibitions, ensuring our selection resonates with the freshest styles endorsed by industry and fashion enthusiasts alike.

settings.title: Curate Limited Garments for One-Time Wear
settings.text: Embracing exclusivity, we curate limited garments meant for one-time wear. Each piece becomes a statement of individuality, allowing you to showcase a truly exceptional sense of style.

settings.title: Procure and Add to the NSC Wardrobe
settings.text: Our commitment to sophistication extends to procurement, elevating your wardrobe with curated elegance. We source garments directly from designers, so every piece is brand new, never worn, straight from the source.

settings.heading: Garment Selection Process
settings.intro: At our haute couture, we take immense pride in our meticulous garment selection process, ensuring that each piece in our collection embodies the epitome of style and sophistication. Our process is driven by industry research, the latest trends, and careful curation to provide you with a unique and exceptional wardrobe experience.
